title: Affine torsion bound for cohomology modules of finite scalar-model constructible complexes
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, an algebraic closure $\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$, a finite intermediate extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite commutative ring $A$ annihilated by a power of $\ell$. Let $\Lambda\in\{A,\mathbf Z_\ell,\mathcal O_E,\mathbf Q_\ell,E\}$, discrete for $A$ and with its induced $\ell$-adic topology otherwise [sk-def-localizing-closure]. Its condensed ring on profinite sets is $P\mapsto C(P,\Lambda)$, with all continuous functions. Let $X$ be an affine scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small étale and pro-étale sites and the small indexing universe [def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-size-convention]. Put $\Lambda_T=p_T^*\Lambda$ and $\mathcal A_T=\operatorname{Mod}_{\Lambda_T}$ for schemes $T$ over $X$, with the ordinary uncompleted derived categories and actual module-derived global sections to abelian groups [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull].

Let $\mathcal C_X$ consist of the finite constant scalar-model constructible modules of [sk-def-sfb-constructible]. A finite constructible complex here means a cochain complex $K^\bullet$ in $\mathcal A_X$ [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] with only finitely many nonzero terms, each in $\mathcal C_X$; the differentials are arbitrary actual $\Lambda_X$-linear sheaf maps, not necessarily maps given by a common constant scalar matrix. Put $N_K=\ker(d^0:K^0\to K^1)/\operatorname{im}(d^{-1}:K^{-1}\to K^0)$, the zeroth cohomology module of this complex. No constructibility assumption is imposed on $N_K$.

Let $d\geq0$ be an integer. Assume $H^q(V_{\mathrm{et}},F)=0$ for every affine étale morphism $V\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], every locally torsion abelian sheaf $F$ on $V_{\mathrm{et}}$, and every integer $q>d$ [def-sc-etale-torsion-cd]. A common annihilator for $F$ is not required. Then for every finite constructible complex $K^\bullet$ as above, every affine pro-étale object $v:U\to X$, and every integer $q>d+2$, one has
$$H^q\bigl(R\Gamma(U_{\mathrm{pro\acute et}},v^*N_K[0])\bigr)=0.$$
The bound is independent of the length of the complex and its differentials. There is no hypothesis of Noetherianity, finite-type structure over a field, invertibility of $\ell$, completeness of $N_K$, or finite-subextension-valued coefficients. Empty schemes, zero complexes and zero coefficient rings are allowed.

proof.text: For any leaf path p, map K.sc 0 by the actual exact pullback p*. Its terms have the three local models from the common tree. Apply the supported three-term scalar cohomology bound with the original affine X and torsion bound d. Exact-functor homology comparison identifies this supported homology with J_p(p*H⁰K). Apply extension, pullback to U, the single functor, derived sections and degree-q homology to this isomorphism to obtain the needed leaf vanishing.

proof.text: Let P be the class of derived module objects on U whose derived section cohomology in degree q is zero. It is isomorphism-closed. Since right-derived sections is triangulated and degree-q homology is homological, the exact same-degree sequence makes P closed under distinguished-triangle extensions. Apply the coefficient-independent finite-tree extension reconstruction with F equal to pullback to U and M equal to H⁰K. All supported leaf objects lie in P by the preceding step. Closure under finite extensions gives P of F(M)[0], exactly the conclusion. The boundedness hypothesis on K is unused, since its three central terms suffice.
